뭐.x: What do you want to eat for lunch?
뭐.e: Spoken short form of 무엇: 뭐예요? 'What is it?'; 뭐 해요? 'What are you doing?'

지내다.m: to get along, to be doing (well/badly); to spend (time), to live
지내다.x: How are you doing these days?
지내다.e: 잘 지내요? = 'How are you doing?' — a very common greeting.
지내다.t: 잘 지냈어요? = 'How have you been?' — a very common greeting when you meet someone after a while.

낮다.x: This chair is a little low.
낮다.t: Don't confuse with the noun 낮 'daytime'. Pronounced [낟따].

사이트.ex: 이 사이트에서 옷을 싸게 살 수 있어요.
사이트.x: You can buy clothes cheaply on this site.

글쎄요.m: well…; I'm not sure; let me see
글쎄요.x: Well, I'm not really sure about that either.
글쎄요.t: A soft way to hesitate or politely disagree without saying no directly.

여전히.x: Ten years have passed, but that restaurant is still delicious.
rel: to be the same as ever

압력.ex: 그는 회사에서 많은 압력을 받고 있어요.
압력.x: He is under a lot of pressure at work.
압력.t: Pronounced [암녁] — nasalization turns ㅂ + ㄹ into ㅁ + ㄴ.

작용.t: 부작용 'side effect' is a very common word built on 작용.

행성.x: Earth is a planet that circles the sun.
행성.e: Literally 'moving star' — planets wander across the night sky.

울리다.m: to ring, sound; to make (someone) cry
울리다.x: A phone suddenly rang in the middle of class.
울리다.e: Causative of 울다 'to cry', which also covers bells and birds 'crying'.
울리다.t: Two senses: 벨이 울리다 'a bell rings' and 아이를 울리다 'make a child cry'.

바비큐.x: In the evening we had a barbecue at the campground.
바비큐.t: The standard spelling is 바비큐, but you'll often see 바베큐 on signs and menus.

지원금.ex: 코로나 때 모든 가정에 지원금이 나왔어요.
지원금.x: During COVID, every household got relief payments.
지원금.t: Homonym alert: 지원하다 (志願) can also mean 'to apply,' as for a job.

익명.x: That person donated a large sum anonymously.

강강술래.ex: 추석 밤에 여자들이 손을 잡고 강강술래를 했어요.
강강술래.x: On Chuseok night, the women held hands and danced ganggangsullae.
강강술래.e: The name's origin is uncertain; a moonlit circle dance with call-and-response singing at Chuseok.

민원실.m: civil service office, public service counter
민원실.x: To get your documents issued, go to the civil service office on the first floor.
민원실.e: 민원 'civil request' plus -실 'room': 민원실, 사무실, 교실.

서러움.m: sorrow, feeling of being wronged or left out
서러움.ex: 아플 때 혼자 있으니까 서러움이 밀려왔어요.
서러움.x: When I was sick and all alone, a wave of self-pity washed over me.
서러움.e: Noun from 서럽다 (to feel sorrowful); the ㅂ becomes 우.

괴로워하다.forms: 괴로워해요 · 괴로워했어요 · 괴로워할 거예요 · 괴로워하지 마세요
괴로워하다.m: to suffer, to be distressed, to agonize
괴로워하다.ex: 친구가 시험에 떨어져서 많이 괴로워하고 있어요.
괴로워하다.x: My friend failed the exam and is really struggling.
괴로워하다.t: Use 괴롭다 for your own feelings, but 괴로워하다 to describe someone else's.

서운함.m: hurt feelings, feeling let down (by someone close)
서운함.ex: 아들이 연락을 안 해서 엄마는 서운함을 느꼈어요.
서운함.x: The mother felt hurt because her son didn't keep in touch.
서운함.e: Noun from 서운하다 'hurt, let down' + -ㅁ; a near-synonym of 섭섭함.
서운함.t: Used when someone close falls short of your expectations; 서운해요 is a gentle way to say 'I'm a bit hurt.'

서슴없이.x: He answered the question without hesitation.

여하튼.m: anyhow, at any rate, in any case
여하튼.ex: 여하튼 이번 일은 우리가 책임져야 합니다.
여하튼.x: At any rate, we have to take responsibility for this matter.
여하튼.e: Literally 'however it may be'; same meaning as 하여튼 with syllables swapped.

껴안다.m: to hug, to embrace; to take on (a problem)
껴안다.x: I gave my friend, whom I hadn't seen in ages, a tight hug.
껴안다.e: 끼다 'to fit in' + 안다 'to hold': holding someone tightly.

애를 쓰다.forms: 애를 써요 · 애를 썼어요 · 애쓰셨어요 (ㅡ drops)
애를 쓰다.m: to make a great effort, to try hard
애를 쓰다.x: I tried hard to forget, but it wasn't easy.
애를 쓰다.e: 애 here means 'anxious effort,' a homonym of 애 'kid.'
애를 쓰다.t: 애쓰셨어요 is a warm way to thank someone for their hard work.

극단적.x: Extreme diets aren't good for your health.
극단적.e: Literally 'of the farthest end'. -적 = '-ic/-al': 경제적, 긍정적.
극단적.t: Pronounced [극딴적]; use 극단적인 before nouns and 극단적으로 as an adverb.

다림질.x: I iron my shirts every weekend.
다림질.e: From 다리다 'to iron' + -질, a suffix for repeated handwork.
다림질.t: Don't confuse 다리다 'to iron' with 달이다 'to boil down (medicine)'; both sound like [다리다].

점유율.ex: 그 회사의 스마트폰 시장 점유율이 크게 늘었어요.
점유율.x: That company's share of the smartphone market grew significantly.
점유율.t: Written -율, not -률, because it follows a vowel.

정신력.x: In a marathon, mental strength matters just as much as stamina.
정신력.t: Pronounced [정신녁], not [정실력] — an exception to the usual ㄴ+ㄹ rule.

억지력.ex: 강한 국방은 전쟁을 막는 억지력이 됩니다.
억지력.x: A strong defense serves as a deterrent that prevents war.
억지력.e: Literally 'power to hold back and stop'.
억지력.t: Don't confuse with 억지 'stubbornness, forcing it' (native word): 억지를 부리다.

표준화.x: Thanks to charger standardization, things became more convenient for consumers.

구인난.x: Small and medium-sized companies are facing a serious labor shortage.
구인난.e: Literally 'person-seeking difficulty'; -난 = shortage or crisis: 구인난, 주택난, 취업난.

수도권.m: the capital region, Seoul metropolitan area
수도권.ex: 한국 인구의 절반 정도가 수도권에 살아요.
수도권.x: About half of Korea's population lives in the capital region.
수도권.t: 수도권 covers Seoul, Incheon and Gyeonggi; its everyday opposite is 지방 (the provinces).

오십보백보.m: a difference that makes no difference; not much better; the pot calling the kettle black
오십보백보.x: The person who was late and the person who was absent are pretty much the same.
오십보백보.e: From Mencius: a soldier who fled fifty paces laughing at one who fled a hundred.

상대성.x: Einstein is famous for his theory of relativity.

입덕.x: I became a fan right after seeing that performance.
입덕.t: Casual fan slang. Pronounced [입떡]. Used as 입덕하다; the opposite is 탈덕 'quitting being a fan'.

감가상각.ex: 자동차는 시간이 지나면 감가상각 때문에 가치가 떨어져요.
감가상각.x: Cars lose value over time because of depreciation.
감가상각.e: 감가 'value reduction' + 상각 'writing off' a cost over time.
감가상각.t: In everyday talk, 감가 alone means resale value dropping: 이 차는 감가가 커요.

포트폴리오.x: He built a portfolio of stocks and bonds.
포트폴리오.e: From English 'portfolio'; also used for a designer's or job applicant's work samples.

기소권.ex: 한국에서는 검찰이 기소권을 대부분 가지고 있어요.
기소권.x: In Korea, the prosecution holds most of the power to indict.

외상후스트레스장애.ex: 사고 이후 그는 외상후스트레스장애로 치료를 받고 있어요.
외상후스트레스장애.x: Since the accident, he has been receiving treatment for PTSD.
외상후스트레스장애.t: In speech, people usually just say PTSD [피티에스디] or 트라우마.

위화감.m: sense of incongruity, feeling out of place, discomfort
위화감.ex: 비싼 차를 자랑하면 주변 사람들에게 위화감을 줄 수 있어요.
위화감.x: Showing off an expensive car can make people around you feel uncomfortable.
위화감.t: Common pattern: 위화감을 주다/조성하다 — often about wealth gaps causing social friction.

정맥.x: The nurse gave an injection into a vein in my arm.
정맥.e: Literally 'quiet vessel' — no strong pulse, unlike an artery.

무기물.x: Water and salt are typical inorganic substances.
무기물.e: Literally 'things without a living mechanism'. 무- = 'without': 무료, 무기물.
무기물.t: Careful: 무기 alone usually means 'weapon', a completely different word.

거문고.ex: 거문고 소리는 낮고 묵직해서 마음을 차분하게 해요.
거문고.x: The geomungo's low, heavy sound calms the mind.
거문고.e: Probably from an old word 고 'zither', also seen in 가얏고, another name for 가야금.
거문고.t: Unlike the finger-plucked 가야금, the 거문고 is struck with a bamboo stick called 술대.

헛헛하다.ex: 친구들이 다 떠나고 나니 마음이 헛헛해요.
헛헛하다.x: Now that all my friends have left, I feel empty inside.
헛헛하다.e: Probably related to 헛- 'empty, in vain', as in 헛수고 'wasted effort'.
헛헛하다.t: Also means slightly hungry: 배가 헛헛하다, close to 출출하다.

정정보도.ex: 신문사는 잘못된 기사에 대해 정정보도를 냈습니다.
정정보도.x: The newspaper published a correction for the inaccurate article.
정정보도.t: Typical collocations: 정정보도를 내다 'to run a correction', 정정보도를 요청하다 'to request one'.

선연히.ex: 그날의 기억이 아직도 선연히 남아 있어요.
선연히.x: The memory of that day still remains vivid.

상관성.ex: 수면 시간과 성적 사이에 상관성이 있습니다.
상관성.x: There is a correlation between sleep time and grades.
